title: PanLL Panel Harness Manifest v2
description: Declares a panel service's endpoints, data sources, capabilities, and runtime configuration. v2 adds Gossamer support alongside Tauri.

service_id.description: Unique identifier for this panel service

default_endpoint.description: Runtime-agnostic endpoint URI (panll:// scheme). Resolved by RuntimeResolver to gossamer:// or tauri:// based on active runtime.

runtime_endpoints.description: Runtime-specific endpoint overrides. If omitted, RuntimeResolver auto-generates from default_endpoint.

http.description: Direct HTTP endpoint for browser-only mode

health_check.description: Health check configuration for the panel service

data_sources.description: Named data source endpoints. Keys are panll:// URIs.

method.description: HTTP method semantics for the data source

description.description: Human-readable description of this data source

capabilities.description: Gossamer capability tokens required by this service. Maps to ResourceKind in Gossamer.ABI.Types.

clade.description: Clade taxonomy path for topic-based event routing

binary_star.description: Declares this panel's relationship to the Binary Star architecture. Panels do not belong to a single pane — they span, flow between, and surface in panes by role. Pane letters: A (Ambient), L (Logic / symbolic), N (Neural), W (World).

spans.description: Panes this panel inhabits (i.e. holds primary state or computation in). A panel may span multiple panes; e.g. a meta-observer that holds both a rules engine (L) and neural models (N) declares spans = ["L", "N"].

flow.description: Ordered sequence of pane letters describing how data or control moves through the panel's pipeline. Order matters; repeats are allowed (a loop returning to L is flow = ["L", "N", "L"]).

surfaces_in.description: Panes where this panel's outputs (findings, dispatches, view updates) become visible to other panels. Typically a subset of, or disjoint from, spans — e.g. a panel that spans [L, N] may surface its dispatches in W.

perspective.description: Vantage point or role within the Binary Star architecture. Canonical values: "observer" (reads/displays state), "meta-observer" (observes other panels' state), "actor" (takes actions on the world), "sensor" (raw data ingestion), "transformer" (converts data between panes). Other values permitted but should be added to this enum over time.

role.description: This service's role in the integration
